run_pybullet_simulation: run a pybullet simulation in DIRECT headless mode by connecting and stepping the simulation loop
load_sdf_scene: load an SDF scene file into the pybullet physics simulation environment
capture_camera_image: capture a 320x240 camera image from the pybullet simulation without segmentation mask
load_egl_renderer: load the EGL renderer plugin for GPU-accelerated headless rendering in pybullet
step_simulation_loop: step the pybullet simulation forward one timestep in a continuous loop
